metadata.notice: 英文释义和词形来自 ECDICT 离线词库。参考英文释义取源词典前 3 条并排除部分明显混淆词义，可能包含较少见词义，未必对应全部中文释义；词形按源词典记录并作保守筛选，不代表全部用法。源数据可能存在错误。

fieldSemantics.definitionEn: Up to the first 3 nonempty source definition lines, excluding audited known homograph mismatches and date-marked biographical proper-name senses for lowercase headwords. Retained lines are verbatim except literal newline expansion and whitespace trim. These are reference senses, not necessarily every Chinese meaning. Absent if empty or all excluded.
fieldSemantics.formsText: Source exchange values with Chinese labels, deterministic order p,d,i,3,r,t,s,0. Same-spelling groups combine labels; values identical to base are hidden. Only documented codes, supported spelling, existing source headwords and compatible source POS pass. No affix generation or model output. Missing means unavailable or conservatively omitted, never that no form exists.
